ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate system \(xOy\), the line \( l_{1}: y_{1}=2x \) intersects with the line \( l_{2}: y_{2}=-x+3 \) at point A. What are the coordinates of point A?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the given, we have
\[
\begin{cases}
y=2x \\
y=-x+3
\end{cases}
\]
Solving these equations, we get:
\[
\begin{cases}
x=1 \\
y=2
\end{cases}
\]
$\therefore$ The coordinates of point A are $\boxed{(1, 2)}$.
